subject: Initial discovery / demo — coordinating AE + SE + Eng + Procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial discovery / demo — coordinating AE + SE + Eng + Procurement

Hi Jordan —

Great to connect yesterday. We'd love to run a short discovery + technical demo to show how Redwood can help Acme reduce inference costs and meet your security requirements. Would next week work? I want to make sure we have both an AE-level convo and a short SE-led technical session so your eng/security/procurement folks can join.

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-06-15 10:00-11:00
- Tue 2026-06-15 15:00-16:00
- Wed 2026-06-16 09:00-10:00

Please let me know who from your side should join (engineering lead + security/procurement contacts), and I'll loop in Neha (our SE) and Aditya (my manager) as needed.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page agenda)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme-robotics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme-robotics.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme-robotics.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-robotics.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo — coordinating AE + SE + Eng + Procurement

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — this looks good. Priya (engineering lead) and I can do Tue 6/15 but only in the afternoon (after 2pm PDT). Carlos (procurement) and Liam (security) would like to sit in for 30-40 minutes at the start to cover contract and security posture questions. Ideally: 2:30-3:30pm PDT on 6/15. Can you confirm Neha can join the SE part? Also, we usually ask vendors to send a brief security questionnaire in advance — Liam will want to review that before the meeting.

Jordan
Head of Platform | Acme Robotics
jordan.ellis@acme-robotics.com

Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo — coordinating AE + SE + Eng + Procurement

Marissa / Jordan —

I can join Tue 6/15 at 14:30 PDT and will plan a 30-40 minute SE demo focused on inference latency, model variants, and private deployment options. I'll leave ~20 mins at the end for technical Q&A.

Marissa, I'll need access to any sample prompts or workloads Jordan wants us to highlight — if you can share before Friday that would be great.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-06-10T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial discovery / demo — coordinating AE + SE + Eng + Procurement

Perfect — I'll lock in Tue 6/15 14:30-15:30 PDT. Agenda: 10-15 min intro / objectives, 30-35 min SE demo (Neha), 15 min procurement/security + next steps.

Action items before the call:
- Jordan/Priya: share 1-2 sample prompts or a brief summary of the inference workload you'd like us to demo (send to Neha)
- Liam: any specific security items you want covered, drop in the security questionnaire (attached)
- Carlos: if procurement has standard T&Cs or PO process notes, send along and we'll bring the right folks

I'll circulate a calendar invite and include the Meet link.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa

Hi all — quick change: our onboarding workshop for another vendor was moved and I will be tied up unexpectedly on Tue 6/15 14:30-15:30. The rest of the eng team can still attend, but I should be on the call. Can we reschedule to Wed 6/16 09:00-10:00 PDT instead? That slot was in Marissa's original list.

Apologies for the short notice — we want the engineering lead present for the demo.

Thanks,
Priya
Engineering Lead | Acme Robotics
